grammar.summary: 本课用现在进行时描写村庄景象，学习 along/across 等移动介词。

points.title: 移动介词 along / across
points.explanation: along 沿着（线性路径）、across 穿过（从一端到另一端）。The dog is running across the grass.

examples.en: They are walking along the banks of the river.

points.title: 照片场景描述
points.explanation: 描述照片时用进行时表现画面瞬间：This is a photograph of our village. 之后再展开细节。

examples.en: Some children are coming out of the building.
examples.cn: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。

exercises.q: The cat is ___ along the wall. (run)
